title: llms.txt must be fetchable over HTTP
untested_rationale: validate-llms-txt.mjs's main() emits this id on a non-2xx HTTP status or a thrown fetch error retrieving LLMS_TXT_URL. No pure-function input can construct an HTTP failure. Covered instead by the production smoke suite's route assertions (audits.yaml B1) and fetchStable's retry-then-fail behavior, exercised live on every scheduled CI run.

spec.name: llms.txt (llmstxt.org)
spec.normative_quote: llmstxt.org specifies the content and format of llms.txt; it does not define behavior for transport-layer failures when a consumer attempts to retrieve it. This id covers this repo's own operational handling of that failure mode.
spec.note: No spec clause applies -- conformance_testable is false by construction, matching rule_class: operational.
spec.verification_note: clause n/a -- rule_class: operational. normative_quote is a self-authored statement about the ABSENCE of external spec coverage for this transport/fetch/presence condition; there is no external normative clause to transcribe or verify against a source.

applicability: N/A -- fires on a transport failure, not on the parsed body.
